name: ANN報道特別番組　東日本大震災から15年
original_name: ANN報道特別番組　東日本大震災から15年
overview: ~Understanding the Disaster Interval~ 15 years after the Great East Japan Earthquake, we are now living in the "disaster interval" between disasters. This special program focuses on people who are preparing for the next major earthquake in the disaster interval!
